items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 8 Dec (UK only). Gilles sits down with legendary Chicago composer, trumpeter and vocalist Peven Everett, who tells us about his musical journey, from his early days in New York playing trumpet for Betty Carter to becoming one of the most prominent vocalists in house music. His career was recently explored in the documentary Peven Everett: Voice of a Generation. Also, Gilles invites Los Angeles-born singer-songwriter and producer Georgia Anne Muldrow into the studio for a chat about her recent projects and collaborations. A prominent figure in the soul, R&B and jazz worlds,…
items.title: A chat with Peven Everett, and Georgia Anne Muldrow in the studio

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 1 Dec (UK only). Gilles plays new music spanning from soul, hip-hop, and jazz, including tracks from Jana Saleh, Melé, and Group Titan. Elsewhere in the show, Gilles is joined by Ohio-born, LA-based producer megiapa, fresh off her jazz-infused debut album, Intentions, and we hear from DJ and promoter Rob Da Bank about the comeback of his legendary party series, Sunday Best. Plus, Gilles shares a special Halloween mix to round things off! Produced by Reduced Listening for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: megiapa in the studio

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 24 Nov (UK only). Gilles welcomes east London soulful singer-songwriter Nao to the studio to present her new album Autumn, created in collaboration with musician and producer Dave Okumu and focusing on the artist’s love for jazz. Autumn is the first of four season-themed records, A Soulful Suite, that will each explore a different genre and musical language that has shaped Nao throughout her life. Plus, Gilles plays lots of new music including tracks from Thakzin, Nabihah Iqbal and Lourenço Rebetez. Produced by Reduced Listening for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: Nao in conversation

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 17 Nov (UK only). Gilles spins new tunes including tracks from JNR Willams, Otis Mensah, and Steve Spacek, and invites jazz saxophonist Tamar Osborn into the studio. Tireless, creative collaborator, Tamar has just released her first EP as a bandleader, Varier : Berlin, which gathers recordings of an improvised session recorded in the German capital. Plus, we hear from Kelvin Mercer, aka Posdnuos, Plug 1 and Pos, a third of the legendary hip-hop outfit De La Soul, sharing an exclusive remix of Stakes Is High by J Dilla, 30 years after the album was released.
